label: R30-style adaptation (CC152K data adaptation only); NOT byte-identical to code_r30v11
base: code_r30v11 (R30 v1.1 + amendment A1 snapshot, gated 1080158)

changes.reason: R30 entry refused any dataset but Flickr; the driver below it (r25_co_train / data.py / evaluation) is the IN2R code that natively supports cc152k_precomp (im_div 1, per_captions 1, .tsv captions, noise_ratio forced 0 by r25_run).

changes.change: data_digests(): caption files train_caps.tsv / dev_caps.tsv for cc152k_precomp
changes.reason: PARENT.json data digest would otherwise try to hash the non-existent Flickr .txt caption files (FileNotFoundError at the boundary save).

changes.change: dev_ranks() (E10 report-only rank pass): per_captions = 1 for cc152k_precomp (was hard-coded 5)
changes.reason: Flickr 5-captions-per-image assumption; CC152K has exactly one caption per image. Same rule as r25_co_train.validate / evaluation.py.

changes.change: byte-identical copy of R27-A1X code_a1x/r27_interface.py: Ctx.image_rows() host-gather of observed-image rows
changes.reason: CC152K train features are 41.2 GiB fp32; the A1 re-encoding put the full array on the GPU. image_rows returns exactly the rows gpu_images()[cols] returns (same bytes, same order); auto mode = GPU-resident iff array + 16 GiB <= GPU memory (RTX PRO 6000 / H100: gpu, L40S: cpu). Gated bitwise for R27-A1X (GATE_A1X.json, Flickr gather 1077656).

not_changed: training recipe / options (R30 H parent + H0 continuation: warmup 5, K 5, i2t+t2i on, 40 co-train epochs, native hinge)
A1 noisy interface (other peer selects candidate identities from its own ID-bearing queue, current peer re-encodes)
GMM split / eval_train / LR schedule / DEV-best rule / save-resume code
cc152k_structure: one image per caption: t2i_index = arange(150000), im_div 1, DEV 1000 images x 1000 captions; no record//5 and no multi-positive assumption is used (observed-ID equality in report-only readouts reduces to the diagonal).
_publication_note: Public excerpt: identity/hash/receipt/host fields and per-problem rows omitted, sample names pseudonymized, numbers unchanged.
